description: Explore public Pinterest trend topics and shopping trend data by region.

categoryNames.description: Friendly Pinterest shopping category names for `shoppingMetrics`, such as `Sofas` or `Wedding dress`. Leave empty to use Pinterest's currently featured shopping categories.
categoryNames.title: Shopping category names

cookies.description: Optional Cookie Editor JSON export for account-relative trend context. Public Trends work without cookies; never share this secret publicly.
cookies.title: Optional Pinterest cookies

cookiesJson.description: Compatibility alias for pasting a Cookie Editor JSON export.
cookiesJson.title: Optional cookies JSON (alias)

days.description: Number of historical days returned for shopping metrics.
days.title: History days

event.description: Pinterest event used for shopping category metrics.
event.title: Shopping signal

mode.description: Choose a public Pinterest Trends dataset.
mode.title: What to collect

predictedDays.description: Number of future days Pinterest supplies in shopping metrics. If a region has no forecast, real historical values are returned instead.
predictedDays.title: Predicted days

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy settings. The actor tries a free AUTO proxy fallback and then direct public access.
proxyConfiguration.title: Optional proxy

region.description: Pinterest Trends region. `GB+IE` is Pinterest's combined Great Britain and Ireland region.
region.title: Region

title: Pinterest Trends Input
